contentSections.heading: Public Company Information
paragraphs: YesStyle Limited is an e-commerce company headquartered in Hong Kong, founded in 2006. The company operates as a subsidiary of YesAsia Holdings Limited, which is publicly listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange under stock code 2209.HK. This means that while YesStyle functions as an online retailer, its parent entity is a public corporation subject to financial audits and regulatory oversight.

YesStyle serves customers across more than 150 countries and regions, providing multi-currency options and localized language interfaces. Transactions are processed in major global currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD) in compliance with international e-commerce standards. The platform maintains dedicated customer support channels for order tracking, product authenticity inquiries, and return procedures.

contentSections.heading: Catalog and Market Position
paragraphs: YesStyle states that it is an authorized distributor for over 400 Korean beauty (K-beauty) brands, while also offering Japanese beauty products and Asian fashion. The catalog covers skincare (serums, essences, toners, sunscreens), makeup, haircare, and accessories.

The company states in its corporate information that it operates as an authorized distributor for over 400 Korean beauty brands, featuring established names such as COSRX, Etude House, Hada Labo, and Rohto, sourcing from brand manufacturers or authorized brand partners. Being backed by a publicly listed parent company (YesAsia Holdings) provides verifiable corporate transparency.

contentSections.heading: Global Shipping and Customer Policies
paragraphs: YesStyle ships to more than 150 countries and regions, all from its warehouse in Hong Kong. Delivery times, shipping fees and taxes for the US, the UK, Canada and Australia are in our [YesStyle shipping guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).
Returns for eligible unopened items in original packaging can be requested via Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) through official customer support.

contentSections.heading: Are YesStyle Products Authentic? Where Is YesStyle From?
paragraphs: YesStyle is from Hong Kong. It was founded there in 2006 and belongs to YesAsia Holdings Limited, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (stock code 2209.HK), which also runs the YesAsia store and AsianBeautyWholesale, a wholesale platform for Asian beauty products.

On authenticity, YesStyle says it is an authorized retailer of more than 400 Korean beauty brands and that it sources from brand manufacturers or their authorized partners. We found no independent audit confirming that claim, so here is what you can check yourself (our suggestion, not YesStyle's):
bullets: On the product page, check that the brand and product name match the brand's official website;
On the box, look for the printed batch code and expiry date, and check the expiry date before opening;
On delivery, check the seal on the product and on the packaging;
If anything looks different from the listing, don't use the product and contact YesStyle customer service first.

contentSections.heading: Tips Before Placing Your Order
paragraphs: When shopping internationally on YesStyle, keep the following practical guidelines in mind:
bullets: Always verify you are browsing the official domain (yesstyle.com) with secure HTTPS encryption before entering payment details.
Check local customs regulations in your country regarding tax-free import thresholds to anticipate potential duty fees upon arrival.
Read product descriptions carefully, including shade indicators, packaging sizes, and ingredient lists, as Asian cosmetics standards may differ from western norms.
Review estimated delivery windows for your region at checkout prior to order placement.
Keep your order confirmation email, transaction ID, and tracking code saved until your package arrives safely.
Inspect the outer box upon delivery: do not accept parcels with broken seals or damaged packaging.

contentSections.heading: Can You Trust YesStyle?
paragraphs: Yes, with the usual checks. YesStyle is based in Hong Kong, has operated since 2006 and is a subsidiary of YesAsia Holdings, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (2209.HK). It states it is an authorized distributor of more than 400 Korean beauty brands, but we found no independent audit of that claim.
In practice: order only on yesstyle.com, check delivery times and fees at checkout, keep your order confirmation and tracking code, and on delivery check batch code, expiry date and seal.
